prose_review.basis: Both explain external AC forcing and identify the source's power-station generator as an example, not the sole possible source.
Impractical rotor speed is confined to the textbook's generator arrangement; neither locale asserts a universal prohibition on high-frequency rotating generators.
Tube oscillator and vacuum triode identity are clear; no semiconductor-transistor substitution.
DC source supplies energy, losses are replenished, sustained oscillation does not require external same-frequency sinusoidal forcing. Clock analogy does not imply losslessness.
LC storage, free decay and controlled replenishment follow source prose. Actual Figure 55 placement/wiring is not checked; connecting a source alone is not said to guarantee oscillation.
fig-55 placeholder preserved; empty text is not proof that the source figure is absent.
ZH caption remains Figure 55's source label; EN caption is Figure 55. Source label metadata is retained. Pixels are unreviewed.

For fixed sinusoidal component amplitudes and a supply-oriented current reference, average transferred power is proportional to cos(phi), maximized at phi=0. Both restrict the statement to the considered component/reference directions, not every real nonlinear anode-current waveform.
Grid-to-cathode potential controls anode current; feedback returns a circuit signal. Suitable phase and strength are necessary, so a connection alone is not enough.

Inductive coupling and induced grid emf match the source and each other. No exact pictured connection is inferred. Original U+0441 is retained, while learner review-workflow text requires removal from display scope.

Ideal inductor current lags voltage by pi/2; induced emf has a polarity-dependent quarter-cycle phase relative to that current. The reinforcing polarity yields in-phase grid drive in this model, and reversal yields the opposite phase. Startup requires net energy gain at small amplitude, not phase alone; nonlinear limiting and per-cycle balance distinguish onset from stable amplitude.
prose_review.source_limit: These are conditional phase/energy relationships from prose, not approval of which terminals or winding direction realize them. Exact $L_с$ identity remains HOLD.
